summary: Build the formal core of the arithmetic the Viridis GHG Ledger applies: an inventory as activity times factor summed over activities, its partition into scopes, its additivity and unit scaling, and the interval a total lies in when each emission factor is known only within bounds, each sealed as a statement under the standing sealing policy and proved under the pinned Lean toolchain.
title: Carbon accounting: inventory arithmetic and emission-factor uncertainty
